name: ts-test-impact
description: WebStorm-style refactorings, cross-file inspections, structural search and navigation for TypeScript, JavaScript and React, plus test impact analysis. Deterministic, offline, no AI.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Results of analyses appear here. Put the cursor on a symbol and pick an analysis, or right-click in the editor.
[$(list-tree) Analyze or Refactor This…](command:tsStructure.actionsAtCursor)
[$(references) Find Usages](command:tsStructure.semanticUsages)
[$(pulse) Data Flow](command:tsStructure.dataFlow)
[$(checklist) Inspect Code…](command:tsStructure.inspectCode)
Shortcuts: Ctrl+Alt+S then a letter (D Data Flow, U Usages, I Inspect, N Nullability…). [Keyboard Shortcuts…](command:tsStructure.editKeybindings)
Not sure where to start? [How Do I…?](command:tsStructure.howDoI), [Guide Me](command:tsStructure.guideMe) or [Choose Features…](command:tsStructure.configureFeatures)

Place the cursor on a function, class, method or symbol and run the analysis.
[$(beaker) Test Impact Analysis](command:tsImpact.analyze)

framework.description: Test framework used to run the impacted tests.

tsStructure.include.markdownDescription: Glob patterns, relative to the workspace folder, for the only files that inspections, Inspect Code, structural search, duplicate detection, mutation tracking, the type assertion audit and dead export results look at (for example `src/**`). A folder such as `src/app` includes everything below it. When empty, every file in the compiler project is included. `#tsStructure.exclude#` is applied after this.

tsStructure.exclude.markdownDescription: Glob patterns, relative to the workspace folder, for files left out of inspections, Inspect Code, structural search, duplicate detection, mutation tracking, the type assertion audit and dead export results (for example `**/generated/**` or `src/legacy/*.ts`). A folder such as `src/legacy` excludes everything below it. Right-click files or folders in the Explorer and choose **Exclude from TypeScript Structure Analysis** to add them.

tsStructure.askForScope.markdownDescription: Ask where to look (whole project, a folder, open editors, changed files, the current file, function or selection) before analyses that cover many files: Inspect Code, Find Duplicates, Dead Exports, Audit Type Assertions and Mutation Tracking in Project. The last choice is offered first. Turn off to always analyze the whole project.

tsStructure.features.testImpact.markdownDescription: **Test Impact Analysis**: Find and run the tests that depend on a symbol or file, and the Impacted Tests view. On by default; turn off to hide its commands and menus. **TypeScript Structure: Choose Features…** changes several at once.

tsStructure.features.refactorings.markdownDescription: **Refactorings**: Change Signature, Safe Delete, Introduce Parameter and Move Members, with their lightbulb entries. On by default; turn off to hide its commands and menus. **TypeScript Structure: Choose Features…** changes several at once.

tsStructure.features.intentions.markdownDescription: **Intention Actions**: Small rewrites in the lightbulb menu, such as flipping an if or converting to a template string. On by default; turn off to hide its commands and menus. **TypeScript Structure: Choose Features…** changes several at once.

tsStructure.features.inspections.markdownDescription: **Inspections**: Live inspections in the Problems panel, Inspect Code and Audit Type Assertions. On by default; turn off to hide its commands and menus. **TypeScript Structure: Choose Features…** changes several at once.

tsStructure.features.dataFlow.markdownDescription: **Data Flow and Mutation Tracking**: Data Flow Path Explorer and Mutation Tracking. On by default; turn off to hide its commands and menus. **TypeScript Structure: Choose Features…** changes several at once.

tsStructure.features.nullability.markdownDescription: **Nullability Path Explorer**: Nullability Path Explorer and the "Explain why this may be undefined" action on TypeScript errors. On by default; turn off to hide its commands and menus. **TypeScript Structure: Choose Features…** changes several at once.

tsStructure.features.usages.markdownDescription: **Semantic Find Usages**: References grouped by reads, writes, calls, imports, types and JSX. On by default; turn off to hide its commands and menus. **TypeScript Structure: Choose Features…** changes several at once.

tsStructure.features.sideEffects.markdownDescription: **Side-Effect Analyzer**: Side-Effect Analyzer and its CodeLens. Optional, off by default: turn on to add its commands and menus. **TypeScript Structure: Choose Features…** changes several at once.

tsStructure.features.promiseRejections.markdownDescription: **Promise Rejection Analyzer**: Where a function’s promise rejections are handled or lost. Optional, off by default: turn on to add its commands and menus. **TypeScript Structure: Choose Features…** changes several at once.

tsStructure.features.deadExports.markdownDescription: **Dead Export Analyzer**: Exports and files nothing reachable from the entry points uses. Optional, off by default: turn on to add its commands and menus. **TypeScript Structure: Choose Features…** changes several at once.

tsStructure.features.exceptionFlow.markdownDescription: **Exception Flow Visualizer**: Where errors are thrown, caught, transformed or swallowed. Optional, off by default: turn on to add its commands and menus. **TypeScript Structure: Choose Features…** changes several at once.

tsStructure.features.duplicates.markdownDescription: **Structural Duplicates**: Find code copied with renamed variables or changed values. Optional, off by default: turn on to add its commands and menus. **TypeScript Structure: Choose Features…** changes several at once.

tsStructure.features.reexports.markdownDescription: **Re-export Chain Navigator**: Follow a name through aliases and barrel files. Optional, off by default: turn on to add its commands and menus. **TypeScript Structure: Choose Features…** changes several at once.

tsStructure.features.structuralSearch.markdownDescription: **Structural Search and Replace**: Search and replace code by shape, and build custom inspections. Optional, off by default: turn on to add its commands and menus. **TypeScript Structure: Choose Features…** changes several at once.

tsStructure.features.hierarchy.markdownDescription: **Inheritance Hierarchy and Override Impact**: Supertypes, subtypes and overrides, and what a change to a member reaches. Optional, off by default: turn on to add its commands and menus. **TypeScript Structure: Choose Features…** changes several at once.

tsStructure.features.dependencyPath.markdownDescription: **Dependency Path Finder**: Why one module depends on another. Optional, off by default: turn on to add its commands and menus. **TypeScript Structure: Choose Features…** changes several at once.

tsStructure.features.graphDiff.markdownDescription: **Dependency Graph Diff**: How imports changed since a Git revision. Optional, off by default: turn on to add its commands and menus. **TypeScript Structure: Choose Features…** changes several at once.

tsStructure.features.argumentFlow.markdownDescription: **Argument Propagation Explorer**: Where a parameter’s values come from and where they go. Optional, off by default: turn on to add its commands and menus. **TypeScript Structure: Choose Features…** changes several at once.

tsStructure.previewRefactorings.description: Show VS Code's Refactor Preview before applying refactorings, so individual changes can be reviewed and unticked.

tsStructure.highlightResults.description: Highlight the locations of the current analysis in open editors: definitions outlined, writes and reads shaded.

tsStructure.results.focusView.markdownDescription: Reveal the TypeScript Structure view when an analysis finishes. Turn off to stay where you are; a status bar message says when a report is ready.

tsStructure.results.historySize.markdownDescription: How many reports **Previous Analysis** and **Next Analysis** keep.

tsStructure.results.rerunOnSave.markdownDescription: Re-run the report in the TypeScript Structure view when you save a file it covers, instead of showing the *Files changed* banner.

tsStructure.lightbulbAnalyses.markdownDescription: Offer analyses in the lightbulb menu on a declaration name, such as **Show data flow of 'total'** on a variable or **Show side effects of f()** on a function. Only analyses whose feature is on are offered.

tsStructure.editorTitleButton.markdownDescription: Show the TypeScript Structure button in the editor title bar of TypeScript and JavaScript files. It opens **Analyze or Refactor This…**.

tsStructure.contextMenu.topLevel.markdownDescription: Show **Find Usages in Current File**, **Semantic Find Usages**, **Data Flow Path Explorer** and **Analyze or Refactor This…** directly in the editor's right-click menu, next to Go to Definition. Everything else stays under **TypeScript Structure**.

enumDescriptions: A spinner in the status bar while an analysis runs.
A notification while an analysis runs.
tsStructure.results.progress.markdownDescription: Where analyses show that they are running. Inspect Code always uses a notification, so it can be cancelled.

tsStructure.results.followCursor.markdownDescription: Select the result row of the place under the editor's cursor, so the TypeScript Structure view shows where you are in the results. Next and Previous Result continue from it.

tsStructure.dataFlow.designPatterns.markdownDescription: Show the **Design patterns** group at the end of the Data Flow report.

tsStructure.safeDelete.confirmUnused.markdownDescription: Ask before Safe Delete removes something nothing uses. Turn off to delete unused, unexported code straight away (Ctrl+Z still undoes it).

enumDescriptions: Every button in the title of the results view.
Only Back, Re-run, Filter, About and Clear; the rest move to the ... menu.
tsStructure.results.toolbar.markdownDescription: Which buttons the title of the **TypeScript Structure** results view shows. You can also hide a single button by right-clicking the title bar.

tsStructure.dataFlow.groupByDirection.markdownDescription: Data Flow: put the functions that write the value under **Flows in** and those that read it under **Flows out**, so each side collapses as one. Off: one group per function after Flows in and Flows out.

tsStructure.inspections.enabled.description: Run the TypeScript Structure inspections on open files and report findings in the Problems panel.

tsStructure.inspections.statusBar.description: Show the number of inspection findings in the active file in the status bar.

enumDescriptions: Inspect while you type, after a short pause.
Inspect only when the file is saved. Faster on big projects.
tsStructure.inspections.run.markdownDescription: When live inspections run on an open file. Files are always inspected when they are opened.

tsStructure.inspections.delay.markdownDescription: Milliseconds to wait after the last keystroke before inspecting, when `#tsStructure.inspections.run#` is `type`. Raise it if typing feels slow in a big project.

tsStructure.inspections.severity.markdownDescription: Severity per inspection, or `off` to disable it. `default` keeps the severity each finding is reported with. Findings can also be suppressed in code with `// ts-structure-ignore-next-line <id>` or `// ts-structure-ignore-file <id>`. Add `"editor.codeActionsOnSave": { "source.fixAll.tsStructure": "explicit" }` to apply preferred fixes on save.

missingAwait.description: Promises that are dropped, including through wrapper functions and helpers.

typeAssertion.description: Type assertions that are unnecessary, widen silently, narrow without a runtime check, or bypass compatibility checks.

tsStructure.missingAwait.ignore.markdownDescription: Functions whose promises may be dropped on purpose, such as fire-and-forget logging. `track` matches `track()` and `analytics.track()`; `*` is a wildcard, as in `logger.*`. A call is also ignored when its promise comes from an ignored function through wrappers.

tsStructure.typeAssertion.ignoreTestFile.description: Don't report type assertions in test files, where mocks and fixtures often need them.

tsStructure.customInspections.markdownDescription: Structural search patterns that run as live inspections. Create them with **Structural Search… → Save as Inspection** and manage them with **Manage Custom Inspections…**.

id.description: Unique id, shown as the diagnostic code custom:<id>.

type.description: Regular expression tested against the matched type.

text.description: Regular expression tested against the matched text.

message.description: Message for each match; $name$ is filled in from the match.

replacement.description: Quick fix template using the pattern placeholders.

files.description: Regular expression tested against file paths; only matching files are inspected.

tsStructure.intentions.disabled.markdownDescription: Intention actions to hide from the lightbulb menu. **TypeScript Structure: Choose Intention Actions…** sets this from a checklist.

tsImpact.maxDepth.description: Maximum number of caller hops followed from the selected symbol.

tsImpact.includeInheritedMembers.description: Also follow calls made through interfaces and base classes that a selected class member implements or overrides. These matches are reported as possible impacts.

tsStructure.deadExports.entryPoints.markdownDescription: Glob patterns, relative to the workspace folder, for the files whose exports are the public API (for example `src/index.ts` or `src/pages/**`). When empty, entry points are read from package.json (`main`, `module`, `exports`, `bin`) and conventional `index`/`main` files.

tsStructure.deadExports.testFilesAreEntr.description: Treat test files as entry points, so exports used only by tests are not reported as dead.

tsStructure.duplicates.minStatements.description: Shortest run of consecutive statements compared by the structural duplicate finder.

tsStructure.duplicates.minTokens.description: Smallest duplicated fragment, in syntax nodes, that is reported.

tsStructure.duplicates.matchRenamedPrope.markdownDescription: Also report copies that use different property or method names, such as `item.price` in one copy and `parcel.weight` in the other. Finds more near-duplicates, with more noise.

tsStructure.duplicates.ignoreTestFiles.description: Leave test files out of project-wide duplicate searches.

tsStructure.argumentFlow.maxDepth.description: How many calls the Argument Propagation Explorer follows in each direction.

tsStructure.codeLens.sideEffects.description: Show a CodeLens above each function summarizing its side effects ("pure", "mutates arguments · I/O", …). Click it for the full Side-Effect Analyzer report.

tsStructure.codeLens.sideEffectsShowPure.markdownDescription: Show the side-effect lens on pure functions too. Turn off to keep lenses only where a function has effects.

tsStructure.codeLens.sideEffectsIgnoreTe.markdownDescription: Leave the side-effect lens out of test files, where mocks and setup make most functions impure.

walkthroughs.title: Get Started with TypeScript Structure
walkthroughs.description: Refactor, inspect and navigate TypeScript and JavaScript across files, in seven short steps.

steps.title: One shortcut for everything
steps.description:
Put the cursor on a function, variable or class in a TypeScript file and press **Ctrl+Alt+Shift+T** (**Analyze or Refactor This…**). Every refactoring and analysis that fits is listed, and you can type to filter. The same list is in the editor's right-click menu under **TypeScript Structure**.
[Analyze or Refactor This…](command:tsStructure.actionsAtCursor)

media.altText: The Analyze or Refactor This list at the cursor

steps.title: Everything from the keyboard
steps.description:
Every analysis has a shortcut: Ctrl+Alt+S (Cmd+Ctrl+S on macOS), then a letter, such as D for Data Flow or U for Find Usages. Not sure which analysis answers your question? Ask How Do I…?
[Show the Shortcuts](command:tsStructure.shortcutSheet)
[How Do I…?](command:tsStructure.howDoI)

steps.title: Refactor across files
steps.description:
With the cursor on a function name, **Change Signature…** (**Ctrl+F6**) renames, adds, removes or reorders parameters and updates every call. **Safe Delete** (**Alt+Delete**) checks every usage first. VS Code's Refactor Preview lets you review each change before it is applied.
[Change Signature…](command:tsStructure.changeSignature)

steps.title: Catch problems as you type
steps.description:
Live inspections find what single-file linters miss, such as a promise dropped through a helper function. Findings appear in the Problems panel; press **Ctrl+.** on one for its fixes. **Inspect Code…** checks a whole file or project.
[Inspect Code…](command:tsStructure.inspectCode)

media.altText: A missing-await finding with its explanation

steps.title: Understand code before changing it
steps.description:
**Semantic Find Usages** (**Alt+F7**) groups references into reads, writes, calls and imports. **Data Flow** shows how a value changes, and **Nullability** shows which paths make it undefined. Results open in the TypeScript Structure view, where you can filter, go back and forward, and re-run them.
[Semantic Find Usages](command:tsStructure.semanticUsages)

media.altText: Semantic Find Usages grouped by kind

steps.title: Run only the tests a change affects
steps.description:
With the cursor on a function, **Test Impact Analysis** finds the tests that reach it, through other functions too, and runs just those.
[Test Impact Analysis](command:tsImpact.analyze)

media.altText: Tests that depend on the selected function

steps.title: Turn on more features
steps.description:
To keep things simple, eleven more analyses start off: side effects, dead exports, duplicates, structural search and replace, exception flow, dependency paths and more. Tick the ones you want; they then appear in the menus.
[Choose Features…](command:tsStructure.configureFeatures)

steps.title: Leave files out
steps.description:
Generated or vendored code can be left out of inspections and project-wide searches: right-click a file or folder in the Explorer and choose **Exclude from TypeScript Structure Analysis**, or edit the whole scope here. Every option is in the settings.
[Edit Analysis Scope…](command:tsStructure.editAnalysisScope)
[Open Settings](command:tsStructure.openSettings)

media.altText: The analysis scope with include and exclude patterns
